answer: An agent economy resists fake identities by making each identity a work-bonded vertex: to join, an agent locks a refundable deposit at a jetty, a small slow-release escrow, and earns reputation only from verified completed work, never from self-declared claims. The deposit unlocks gradually, like a river carving its bed, so a cloned identity starts with zero history and must pay the same deposit and redo the same work. Forging 1,000 fake agents costs 1,000 deposits plus 1,000 verified jobs; honest agents keep their stake and compound trust.
